SELECT A.CATEGORY_NUM as categorynum, A.BOARD_NUM as boardnum, (SELECT CATEGORY_NAME FROM CATEGORY_BOARD_TEST WHERE A.CATEGORY_NUM = CATEGORY_NUM) as categoryname, A.TITLE as title, A.EXIST_IMGFILE as existimgfile, (SELECT NICKNAME FROM USERS_TEST WHERE USERID = A.WRITER) as writer, DATE_FORMAT(A.REGISTERED_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') as registerdate, null as content, B.VIEW_COUNT as viewcount, (B.RECOMMEND_COUNT - B.NO_RECOMMEND_COUNT) as recommendcount, null as sqltext FROM BOARD_TEST A, BOARD_DATA_TEST B WHERE B.I_BOARD_NUM = CONCAT(LPAD(A.CATEGORY_NUM, 5, '0'), A.BOARD_NUM) AND A.DELETED = 'N'
ORDER BY registerdate desc LIMIT #{params.pagination.limitStart}, #{params.recordSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BOARD_TEST A WHERE A.DELETED = 'N'

SELECT B.CATEGORY_NUM as categorynum, IFNULL(A.BOARD_NUM, 0) as boardnum FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CATEGORY_NUM , RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY CATEGORY_NUM ORDER BY BOARD_NUM DESC) AS BOARD_RANKING, BOARD_NUM FROM BOARD_TEST) TEMP WHERE TEMP.BOARD_RANKING = 1) A RIGHT JOIN CATEGORY_BOARD_TEST B ON A.CATEGORY_NUM = B.CATEGORY_NUM

SELECT CATEGORY_NUM AS CATEGORYNUM, (SELECT CATEGORY_NAME FROM CATEGORY_BOARD_TEST CBT WHERE A.CATEGORY_NUM = CATEGORY_NUM) AS CATEGORYNAME, BOARD_NUM AS BOARDNUM, TITLE, CONTENT FROM BOARD_TEST A WHERE CATEGORY_NUM = #{arg0} AND BOARD_NUM = #{arg1}
SELECT (RECOMMEND_COUNT - NO_RECOMMEND_COUNT) as recommend_count FROM BOARD_DATA_TEST WHERE I_BOARD_NUM = #{arg0}

mapper.select: SELECT iboardnum, commentno, parentcommentno, parentwriter, level, registereddate, writer, content, modifieddate, recommendcount, norecommendcount, deleted FROM ( WITH RECURSIVE CTE AS ( SELECT I_BOARD_NUM as iboardnum, COMMENT_NO as commentno, PARENT_COMMENT_NO as parentcommentno, CAST("" as NCHAR(16)) as parentcommentwriter, 1 as level, REGISTERED_DATE as registereddate, WRITER as writer, CONTENT as content, MODIFIED_DATE as modifieddate, RECOMMEND_COUNT as recommendcount, NO_RECOMMEND_COUNT as norecommendcount, DELETED as deleted, CAST(CONVERT(COMMENT_NO, CHAR) as NCHAR(100)) as path FROM BOARD_COMMENT_TEST WHERE PARENT_COMMENT_NO = 0 AND I_BOARD_NUM = #{iboardnum} UNION all SELECT A.I_BOARD_NUM as iboardnum, A.COMMENT_NO as commentno, A.PARENT_COMMENT_NO as parentcommentno, B.WRITER as parentcommentwriter, B.LEVEL + 1 as level, A.REGISTERED_DATE as registereddate, A.WRITER as writer, A.CONTENT as content, A.MODIFIED_DATE as modifieddate, A.RECOMMEND_COUNT as recommendcount, A.NO_RECOMMEND_COUNT as norecommendcount, A.DELETED as deleted, CONCAT(B.PATH,'-',A.COMMENT_NO) as path FROM BOARD_COMMENT_TEST A, CTE B WHERE A.PARENT_COMMENT_NO = B.commentno AND B.iboardnum = #{iboardnum} ) SELECT iboardnum, commentno, parentcommentno, (select nickname from users_test where userid = CTE.parentcommentwriter) as parentwriter, level, registereddate, (select nickname from users_test where userid = CTE.writer) as writer, content, modifieddate, recommendcount, norecommendcount, deleted FROM CTE ORDER BY convert(path, unsigned), path ) A LIMIT #{params.pagination.limitStart}, #{params.recordSize}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BOARD_COMMENT_TEST WHERE I_BOARD_NUM = #{iboardnum}
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(COMMENT_NO), 0) AS COMMENT_NO FROM BOARD_COMMENT_TEST
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(SEQ), 0) AS COMMENT_NO FROM BOARD_COMMENT_TEST WHERE I_BOARD_NUM = #{arg0} AND COMMENT_NO = #{arg1}
SELECT IFNULL(MIN(1), 0) FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BOARD_COMMENT_RECOMMEND_HISTORY_TEST WHERE COMMENT_NO = #{arg0} AND USERID = #{arg1} )
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD_TEST A SET A.TITLE = #{arg2}, A.CONTENT = #{arg3}, A.MODIFIED_DATE = (SELECT SYSDATE()) WHERE A.CATEGORY_NUM = #{arg0} AND A.BOARD_NUM = #{arg1}

UPDATE BOARD_COMMENT_TEST SET RECOMMEND_COUNT = (CASE WHEN 'Y' = #{arg2} THEN (RECOMMEND_COUNT + 1) ELSE RECOMMEND_COUNT END), NO_RECOMMEND_COUNT = (CASE WHEN 'Y' = #{arg2} THEN NO_RECOMMEND_COUNT ELSE (NO_RECOMMEND_COUNT + 1) END) WHERE I_BOARD_NUM = #{arg0} AND COMMENT_NO = #{arg1}
